scanNote:
WORKBOOK 15-UNITNING UCHINChI BETI (64-bet, PDF 62). Yuqorida chapda to'q sariq '15' va 'Surf the Net!'.

CHAP USTUN:
9) 'The students in Mr Penny's class are having a test. Look at his instructions and report them, as in the example.' SURAT: Mr Penny (yosh o'qituvchi) atrofida 8 ta gap pufakchasi: 1 Don't talk during the test. 2 Don't bring any books into the classroom. 3 Raise your hands if you have any questions. 4 Write your names clearly at the top of the page. 5 Use a pencil, not a pen. 6 Write neatly. 7 Don't look at anyone else's paper. 8 Stop writing at five o'clock. Namuna: 1 Mr Penny told them not to talk during the test. 2-8 ......
10) 'Read the reported conversation, then complete the actual conversation using direct speech.' Matn: I asked Nancy where she lived, and she told me that she lived in Perth, Australia. I also asked her how old she was and she told me that she was thirteen years old. When I asked her if she had any hobbies, she told me that she had a lot of hobbies. She added that she enjoyed swimming, playing volleyball and that she also liked collecting stamps. I told her that I collected stamps too, and that I had over 100 stamps from many different countries. I asked her how many she had and she told me that she had about 220 from all over the world. I asked her if she had many friends and she told me that she did, but only two of them were her best friends. Their names are Amy and Ellen. Dialog: Jenny: Where do you live? Nancy: I 1) ...... Perth, Australia. Jenny: How 2) ......? Nancy: I 3) ...... . Jenny: 4) ...... any hobbies? Nancy: 5) ...... hobbies. I 6) ...... I also 7) ...... . Jenny: 8) ......, too! I 9) ...... from different countries. How 10) ......? Nancy: I 11) ...... from all over the world. Jenny: 12) ...... many friends? Nancy: Yes, 13) ......, but 14) ...... . Their names are Amy and Ellen.

O'NG USTUN:
11) 'Read the sentences below and underline the correct linking word/phrase.' 1 For example/In conclusion, I think that owning a motorcycle has both good and bad points. 2 Shopping at second-hand shops has many advantages. Firstly/Also, you can buy quality clothes for very low prices. 3 The clothes in this shop are beautiful. What is more/On the other hand, they aren't expensive. 4 Being a nurse is a rewarding job, but/also it can be tiring at times. 5 Travelling by yourself can be very exciting. Finally/On the other hand, it can be dangerous. 6 All in all/Unfortunately, I believe that owning a mobile phone makes our lives easier. 7 John is a very generous man. For example/However, he loves giving gifts to his friends. 8 The Grill House is a great restaurant for meat lovers. Also/However, if you are a vegetarian, you should try Green Leaves on Broad Street.
'Communication: Exclamations' (to'q sariq sarlavha).
12) 'Fill in How or What a(n), then act out the dialogue in pairs.' A: I would like to buy a new music system. B: This is our latest model. It takes up to ten CDs. A: Wow! 1) ...... amazing CD player! B: You can programme it to play the songs in any order and repeat your favourite songs as many times as you like! A: 2) ...... clever! How much is it? B: It's £880. It also comes with a free gift - this leather CD-storage case. A: 3) ...... nice idea! I like that! B: Would you like a demonstration of how to use the CD player? A: Oh, yes! 4) ...... kind! Thank you!

Bet raqami: pastda chapda '64'.

exercises.instructionEn: The students in Mr Penny's class are having a test. Look at his instructions and report them, as in the example. (1 Don't talk during the test. 2 Don't bring any books into the classroom. 3 Raise your hands if you have any questions. 4 Write your names clearly at the top of the page. 5 Use a pencil, not a pen. 6 Write neatly. 7 Don't look at anyone else's paper. 8 Stop writing at five o'clock.)
exercises.instructionUz: Mr Penny sinfidagi o'quvchilar test topshirishyapti. Uning ko'rsatmalariga qarang va namunadagidek ko'chirma gapga aylantiring. (1 Test paytida gaplashmang. 2 Sinfga kitob olib kirmang. 3 Savolingiz bo'lsa qo'l ko'taring. 4 Ismingizni bet tepasiga aniq yozing. 5 Ruchka emas, qalam ishlating. 6 Ozoda yozing. 7 Boshqaning qog'oziga qaramang. 8 Soat beshda yozishni to'xtating.)
exercises.explanationUz:
BUYRUQLARNI KO'ChIRMA GAPGA
  AYLANTIRISh (coursebook 110-bet).

  Buyruq → told + kim + TO + fe'l
  Inkor buyruq → told + kim + NOT TO
    + fe'l

  'Don't talk' → told them NOT TO
    talk
  'Raise your hands' → told them TO
    raise THEIR hands
  'Write your names' → told them to
    write THEIR names


⚠ 'YOUR' → 'THEIR':

  Egalik olmoshi ham o'zgaradi.


⚠ 'ANYONE ELSE'S PAPER':

  = boshqa birovning qog'ozi.


⚠ 'NEATLY':

  = ozoda, chiroyli qilib.

exercises.instructionEn: Read the reported conversation, then complete the actual conversation using direct speech. Text: I asked Nancy where she lived, and she told me that she lived in Perth, Australia. I also asked her how old she was and she told me that she was thirteen years old. When I asked her if she had any hobbies, she told me that she had a lot of hobbies. She added that she enjoyed swimming, playing volleyball and that she also liked collecting stamps. I told her that I collected stamps too, and that I had over 100 stamps from many different countries. I asked her how many she had and she told me that she had about 220 from all over the world. I asked her if she had many friends and she told me that she did, but only two of them were her best friends. Their names are Amy and Ellen.
exercises.instructionUz: Ko'chirma gapdagi suhbatni o'qing, so'ng asl suhbatni to'g'ridan-to'g'ri nutq bilan to'ldiring. Matn: Men Nensidan qayerda yashashini so'radim, u Avstraliyaning Pert shahrida yashashini aytdi. Yana necha yoshdaligini so'radim - u 13 yoshda ekanini aytdi. Sevimli mashg'ulotlari bormi deb so'raganimda, ko'p ekanini aytdi. U suzish, voleybol o'ynashni yoqtirishini va marka yig'ishni ham yaxshi ko'rishini qo'shimcha qildi. Men ham marka yig'ishimni va turli mamlakatlardan 100 dan ortiq markam borligini aytdim. Unda nechta borligini so'radim - u butun dunyodan 220 ga yaqin borligini aytdi. Do'stlari ko'pmi deb so'radim - u ha dedi, lekin faqat ikkitasi eng yaqin do'stlari. Ularning ismlari Emi va Ellen.
exercises.explanationUz:
KO'ChIRMA GAPDAN TO'G'RIDAN-TO'G'RI
  NUTQQA - TESKARI ISh.

  Zamon BIR QADAM OLDINGA:
    lived → LIVE
    was → AM
    had → HAVE
    enjoyed → ENJOY
    collected → COLLECT
  Olmosh: she → I; her → you.
  Savol: 'asked her how old she was'
    → 'How OLD ARE YOU?'
  'asked her if she had' → 'DO YOU
    HAVE ...?'


⚠ 'I ALSO ...':

  = men ham.


⚠ 'OVER 100':

  = 100 dan ortiq.


⚠ 'FROM ALL OVER THE WORLD':

  = butun dunyodan.

exercises.instructionEn: Read the sentences below and underline the correct linking word/phrase.
exercises.instructionUz: Quyidagi gaplarni o'qing va to'g'ri bog'lovchi so'z/iborani tanlang.
exercises.explanationUz:
BOG'LOVChI SO'ZLAR (coursebook
  111-bet).

  In conclusion / All in all = xulosa
    qilib (oxirida)
  Firstly = birinchidan
  Also / What is more = shuningdek,
    bundan tashqari (qo'shimcha)
  But / However / On the other hand
    = lekin / ammo / boshqa tomondan
    (qarama-qarshi)
  For example = masalan
  Finally = nihoyat
  Unfortunately = afsuski

  1 'I think ... both good and bad'
    → IN CONCLUSION (xulosa)
  2 birinchi sabab → FIRSTLY
  3 ikkala ijobiy → WHAT IS MORE
  4 qarama-qarshi → BUT
  5 qarama-qarshi → ON THE OTHER
    HAND
  6 xulosa → ALL IN ALL
  7 misol → FOR EXAMPLE
  8 qarama-qarshi → HOWEVER


⚠ 'REWARDING':

  = qoniqish beradigan.


⚠ 'A VEGETARIAN':

  = vegetarian (go'sht yemaydigan).

items.textEn: For example/In conclusion, I think that owning a motorcycle has both good and bad points.
items.uz: Xulosa qilib, mototsikl egasi bo'lishning ham yaxshi, ham yomon tomonlari bor deb o'ylayman.
items.whyUz: ⚠ 'I think ... both good and bad points' - xulosa gapi → 'In conclusion'.

items.textEn: Shopping at second-hand shops has many advantages. Firstly/Also, you can buy quality clothes for very low prices.
items.uz: Ishlatilgan buyumlar do'konida xarid qilishning ko'p afzalliklari bor. Birinchidan, sifatli kiyimlarni juda arzon narxda olish mumkin.

items.textEn: The clothes in this shop are beautiful. What is more/On the other hand, they aren't expensive.
items.uz: Bu do'kondagi kiyimlar chiroyli. Bundan tashqari, ular qimmat emas.

items.textEn: Being a nurse is a rewarding job, but/also it can be tiring at times.
items.uz: Hamshiralik qoniqish beradigan ish, lekin ba'zan charchatishi mumkin.

items.textEn: Travelling by yourself can be very exciting. Finally/On the other hand, it can be dangerous.
items.uz: Yolg'iz sayohat qilish juda qiziqarli bo'lishi mumkin. Boshqa tomondan, xavfli bo'lishi mumkin.

items.textEn: All in all/Unfortunately, I believe that owning a mobile phone makes our lives easier.
items.uz: Umuman olganda, mobil telefon hayotimizni osonlashtiradi deb hisoblayman.
items.whyUz: ⚠ Xulosa, ijobiy → 'All in all' ('Unfortunately' = afsuski - mos emas).

items.textEn: John is a very generous man. For example/However, he loves giving gifts to his friends.
items.uz: Jon juda saxiy odam. Masalan, u do'stlariga sovg'a berishni yaxshi ko'radi.

items.textEn: The Grill House is a great restaurant for meat lovers. Also/However, if you are a vegetarian, you should try Green Leaves on Broad Street.
items.uz: Grill House go'sht sevuvchilar uchun ajoyib restoran. Ammo, agar vegetarian bo'lsangiz, Broad Street'dagi Green Leaves'ni sinab ko'ring.

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in How or What a(n), then act out the dialogue in pairs.
exercises.instructionUz: How yoki What a(n) qo'ying, so'ng dialogni juft bo'lib ijro eting.
exercises.explanationUz:
UNDOV GAPLAR (coursebook 111-bet).

  WHAT A(N) + (sifat) + OT!
    What an amazing CD player!
    What a nice idea!
  HOW + SIFAT!
    How clever!
    How kind!

  ⚠ Ot bo'lsa → What a/an;
    faqat sifat bo'lsa → How.


⚠ 'TO PROGRAMME':

  = dasturlamoq (BrE imlo).


⚠ 'IT TAKES UP TO TEN CDS':

  = o'nta CD sig'adi.


⚠ 'A DEMONSTRATION':

  = ko'rsatib berish, namoyish.


⚠ 'LEATHER':

  = charm.
